a08.title: Bow and Heart Gift Set
a08.descriptionHtml:
A bow of hearts, with a heart below. The pendant and each earring carry the same bow of two heart cut clear cubic zirconia in fine pave rims, with a heart cut stone in a pave halo hanging below the knot, and the pendant hangs on a fine gold tone cable chain.

STYLING TIP: Give the set; wear the earrings alone on the days after.

Details

  • Set: One pendant necklace and one pair of drop earrings, matching
  • Bow: Two heart cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6mm each, in fine pave rims
  • Drop: Heart cut clear cubic zirconia in a pave halo, approximately 9mm
  • Earrings: Approximately 14mm long, stud fitting
  • Pendant: Approximately 14mm long
  • Chain: Fine cable chain, length to confirm
  • Material: 316L stainless steel with a PVD gold tone finish, as labelled by the supplier

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

a12.title: Heart Solitaire Huggies
a12.descriptionHtml:
A heart below a plain hoop. Each earring is a smooth, polished gold tone huggie of about 15mm with a heart cut clear cubic zirconia of about 6.5mm hanging below it in a closed bezel.

STYLING TIP: Every day, or with a stud in a second piercing.

Details

  • Hoop: Plain polished huggie, approximately 15mm, hinged snap closure
  • Drop: Heart cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6.5mm, in a closed bezel
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Material: Stainless steel, as on the supplier's card

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

a16.title: Herringbone Teardrop Necklace
a16.descriptionHtml:
A polished V and one clear drop. A flat herringbone chain about 3mm wide turns into two smooth gold tone bars that meet in a V at the front, and a pear cut clear cubic zirconia of about 8 x 11mm hangs point up from the point of the V.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone with a white top or a deep neckline.

Details

  • Chain: Flat herringbone chain, approximately 3mm wide
  • Front: Two polished bars, approximately 15mm each, meeting in a V
  • Drop: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 8 x 11mm, hanging point up in a claw setting
  • Length: Approximately 45cm (to confirm)
  • Material: 316L stainless steel with a PVD gold tone finish, as labelled by the supplier

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
